unlisted_practices: Aligning LLM behavior to CBT therapeutic strategies via prompting or instructions to elicit automatic thoughts
Testing whether an LLM therapist pauses and waits for disengaged simulated patients rather than pressing with questions

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a new tailored LLM (LLM4CBT) for cognitive behavioral therapy using simulated and retrospective conversation data. It evaluates a newly designed model/instruction alignment rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
